text: 金十数据8月6日讯，新铝时代公告，公司拟通过发行股份及支付现金方式购买东莞市宏联电子有限公司100%股权并募集配套资金，近日已收到中国证监会批复，同意公司向陈旺等19名交易对方发行股份购买相关资产，并同意募集配套资金不超过7.87亿元。
text_en: Jin10 Data, August 6: Xinlu Times announced that the company plans to acquire 100% equity of Dongguan Honglian Electronics Co., Ltd. through issuance of shares and cash payment, along with raising supporting funds. It recently received CSRC approval to issue shares to 19 counterparties including Chen Wang to acquire the relevant assets, and approved raising supporting funds of no more than 787 million yuan.
